shots.name: Upper-Left Flipper
shots.notes: A full-size flipper facing sideways, halfway up the left side. Feeds the Bracelet target and is the intended way to reach the spiral.

shots.name: Car Crunch Flipper
shots.notes: The sole flipper inside the Car Crunch mini-playfield, used to batter the car model itself.

shots.name: Right-Ramp Auto-Flipper
shots.notes: A rotating paddle at the top of the raised right ramp, spinning at constant speed with no player control. Miss sneaking a ball past it and you get nothing off that shot — no points, no switches.

shots.name: E. Honda Hole
shots.notes: When E. Honda isn't lit, this hole spots a TORPEDO letter. It's also the standard destination for the skill-shot plunge, the left ramp's kickout, the left underpass kickout, and the left sinkhole kickout.

shots.name: M. Bison / Balrog Hole
shots.notes: Carries two opponents at once. Unlit, it spots a TORPEDO letter until the first Torpedo Multiball, scores an escalating award, and resets each ball. Also receives the spiral's kickout.

shots.name: Blanka Hole
shots.notes: Just past the upper-left flipper. Unlit, it advances the Car Crunch count.

shots.name: Zangief Ramp
shots.notes: Active when lowered. Unlit, scores 3M and kicks out through the E. Honda hole. An unlit hit raises the ramp, exposing the underpass below for a shot at Sagat.

shots.name: Sagat Underpass
shots.notes: Only open while the left ramp is raised. Unlit, worth 4M and kicks one barrel toward Multiball — four barrels starts it outright. Kicks out through the E. Honda hole.

shots.name: Dhalsim Sinkhole
shots.notes: Just right of the left ramp. Unlit, scores the Flame award for 2M and kicks out through the E. Honda hole.

shots.name: Guile Loopback
shots.notes: Just right of the top pop bumper and one of the toughest shots on the table — a very small sweet spot, built for the left flipper though an occasional right-flipper backhand can reach it. Unlit, it spots a GUILE letter.

shots.name: Ken & Ryu Spiral
shots.notes: Designed for the upper-left flipper; a stray ball off the right flipper can occasionally ricochet in off the post above E. Honda. Both opponents light together, but a lit shot only scores one of them at a time. Kicks out through the M. Bison hole.

shots.name: Chun-Li Ramp
shots.notes: Active when lowered. A shot up sends the ball onto the raised mini-playfield with the auto-flipper; get past it and you drop into the left inlane, scoring Chun-Li when lit or an escalating unlit award otherwise. An unlit hit raises the ramp, exposing Vega below.

shots.name: Vega Underpass
shots.notes: Only open while the right ramp is raised. Unlit, scores a random award — points, extra ball, multiball, or letters toward GUILE, TORPEDO or FIGHTER. Feeds the top pop bumper on the way out.

shots.name: Bracelet Target
shots.notes: A plastic target with a metal pin at its center, sitting just above the spiral's entrance. The second half of the skill shot.

shots.name: Extra Ball Target
shots.notes: The white target between two red ones near the back center. Only the white center counts, and only while the purple light is flashing.

shots.name: Green Targets
shots.notes: Three plastic targets behind the Extra Ball target, marked by green lights. A single pop bumper sits with them.

shots.name: Fighter Targets
shots.notes: Two sideways targets just left of the right ramp.

shots.name: Slingshots
shots.notes: The standard pair above the lower flippers. Score little on their own, but roll the double light and pay 3M each during Torpedo Multiball.

shots.name: Top Pop Bumper
shots.notes: Fed by the Vega underpass eject hole; sits with the Green Targets and can chain several hits from a single feed.

shots.name: Shooter Lane
shots.notes: Manual plunger, timed to a 'Ready, Set, Shoot' callout. The ball always rides the habitrail down into the Blanka hole — timing only changes the value it sets, not the destination.

shots.name: Car Crunch Mini-Playfield
shots.notes: A walled sub-playfield under the main one, with its own flipper, ball, and a model car that crunches up as you hit it.

goals.title: Skill Shot: The Bracelet
goals.summary: One continuous skill shot rather than a menu of them: time the plunger release to the callout, then finish it on the Bracelet as the ball feeds off the upper-left flipper.
goals.reward: Doubled bracelet value, from 10M up to 40M

steps.action: Time your release to the 'Shoot!' callout, then catch the feed on the upper-left flipper and hit dead center
steps.detail: A clean-timed release sets a 20M bracelet value (5-15M if you're early or late); a dead-center hit doubles whatever value you set. Miss and it turns into a Hurry-Up counting down to zero — nothing banks from the release alone. Lit on the way through, this also defeats your first opponent.

goals.title: Defeat Opponents, Pick Your Prize
goals.summary: Defeating opponents is the spine of the whole game — every one you beat hands you a flipper-selectable choice, and the valuable pick is almost never the points.
instructions: Three opponents are lit at a time; make the matching shot to defeat whoever's lit
Every defeat offers two choices, selected with the flippers — the left-flipper choice is usually flat points, the right-flipper choice is usually the better prize

Prizes run in order: Car Crunch, Multiball, Roaming Ninjas, Multiball, Hurry-Up Extra Ball, add 3 letters to TORPEDO, Multiball, add 2 letters to GUILE, Double Score, complete FIGHTER outright — the 11th opponent gives only a message, and the 12th starts the Champion Challenge
Wait more than 5 seconds and the game locks in the left-flipper choice for you
When in doubt, take Multiball whenever it's on offer
goals.reward: A meaningful prize — Multiball, a mode, or a free letter — every second opponent, flat points the rest of the time

goals.title: Chase the Double Light
goals.summary: A red 'double' light rides on one unlit opponent at a time, doubling whatever that shot would normally pay. Clip a slingshot or the top pop bumper to roll it onto someone else.
goals.reward: Double the shot's normal unlit reward

steps.action: Hit a slingshot or the top pop bumper to roll the double light
steps.detail: It jumps to a different unlit opponent each time you clip one

steps.action: Shoot whichever opponent is currently carrying the double light
steps.detail: Two TORPEDO letters instead of one, two barrels instead of one, 6M instead of 3M, two random awards instead of one — whatever that shot normally pays, doubled

goals.title: Spell GUILE
goals.summary: The loopback next to the pop bumper has the smallest sweet spot on the table, and it's the only place GUILE ever gets spelled.
goals.reward: First completion: extra ball, or 50M with extra balls off. Every completion after: 50M

steps.action: Loop the ball through while unlit
steps.detail: Spots one GUILE letter; the shot is built for the left flipper, though a backhand off the right can reach it in a pinch

goals.title: Spell FIGHTER
goals.summary: Two sideways targets by the right ramp spell FIGHTER a letter at a time, lighting a flipper-selectable Special once it's complete.
goals.reward: Special, lit at a flipper-selectable in/outlane

steps.action: Complete both targets
steps.detail: Spots one FIGHTER letter per completed pair

goals.title: Light the Extra Ball
goals.summary: Work the three Green Targets enough and the white center target lights for 10-15 seconds — hit anything but dead center in that window and it's wasted.
goals.reward: Extra ball, repeatable as many times as you can relight it

steps.action: Work all three Green Targets
steps.detail: A couple of full passes lights the Extra Ball target

steps.action: Hit the white center target while it's flashing
steps.detail: The red side targets don't count, and there's no grace period once the light stops

goals.title: Car Crunch
goals.summary: A mini-playfield below the main one: crunch the car with its own flipper before the clock runs out, and the clock gets tighter with every round you clear.
goals.reward: 5M round one, 10M round two, 30M round three and beyond

steps.action: Batter the car with the mini-playfield flipper
steps.detail: 2 to 5 hits crunches it, depending on how hard you're hitting

steps.action: Finish before time runs out
steps.detail: About 8 seconds on round one, 5-6 on round two, only 2-3 by round three and beyond

goals.title: Roaming Ninjas
goals.summary: Two of the eight opponent shots light at random, one on each half of the table, for five seconds at a time — chain as many as you can before the round ends.
goals.reward: 5M, 20M, 50M, then 100M for the first through fourth hits; there's no fifth shot

steps.action: Take whichever shot lights on your side
steps.detail: Value climbs with each hit across the whole round: 5M, then 20M, then 50M, then 100M

steps.action: Stay ready on both halves of the table
steps.detail: A lit shot stays lit for its full five seconds, so the same hole can pay twice in a row on a lucky rebound

goals.title: Count-Up
goals.summary: The reverse of a Hurry-Up: the M. Bison hole's value climbs from a 3M floor, with no grace period for a miss.

steps.action: Time your shot for the peak value
steps.detail: Climbs 100K at a time up to 10M, pauses, then jumps 1M at a time up to 48M — miss the top by a hair and you get nothing

goals.title: 1-2 Punch
goals.summary: A genuine two-shot combo on the clock: Blanka, then Ken & Ryu, inside about twenty seconds.
goals.reward: Extra ball the first time; 25M then 50M afterward

steps.action: Complete Blanka first
Finish at the spiral within about twenty seconds
steps.detail: First time through in a game pays an extra ball outright

goals.title: Double Score Round
goals.summary: Four shots light for the double light's other trick: clear all four inside twenty seconds and your entire score doubles. The game deliberately picks the hardest shots it can find.

steps.action: Clear the first three lit shots
steps.detail: Worth 5M, 10M and 15M in order — expect Guile or the spiral to be among them

steps.action: Hit the fourth lit shot before time runs out
steps.detail: Doubles your entire score instead of paying points

goals.title: Multiball: The Jackpot Ladder
goals.summary: A progressive jackpot multiball with a fixed shot order — clear it in sequence and the eighth jackpot becomes a repeatable Super Jackpot.
goals.reward: 5M through 35M in order, then a repeatable 300M Super Jackpot

steps.action: Clear the first opener — either one, in any order
steps.detail: Multiball itself usually starts as the right-flipper prize after your 2nd, 4th, 6th, 8th or 10th opponent, though four barrels or a lucky random roll also qualify it. This opener is worth 5M.

steps.action: Clear the other opener
steps.detail: Worth 10M

steps.action: The third jackpot is forced by which opener you hit first
steps.detail: Worth 15M

steps.action: The fourth jackpot finishes that pair
steps.detail: Worth 20M

steps.action: The fifth jackpot is always the same shot
steps.detail: Worth 25M

steps.action: Sixth jackpot, same order every time
steps.detail: Worth 30M

steps.action: Seventh jackpot — one of the harder shots to land on purpose
steps.detail: Worth 35M

steps.action: The eighth jackpot is the repeatable Super Jackpot
steps.detail: Worth 300M and reshootable until the multiball ends — tournament settings reset the ladder back to 5M after one instead

goals.title: Torpedo Multiball
goals.summary: A three-ball frenzy where every single switch pays 3M. Getting there is just a matter of spelling TORPEDO at the two starting holes.
goals.reward: Every switch worth 3M for the duration (roughly 100M on an average run) — this is the only end-of-ball bonus in the game, so don't tilt once it's qualified

steps.action: Spot TORPEDO letters while unlit
steps.detail: One letter per hit before the first Torpedo Multiball; the double light adds a second letter, and choosing 'add 3 to TORPEDO' after your 6th opponent adds three at once

steps.action: Either hole spots a letter
Complete TORPEDO to start the frenzy
steps.detail: Both holes flash once only one letter remains; a plunge that lands lit banks it instantly

goals.title: Champion Challenge
goals.summary: Defeat all twelve opponents once to unlock the Challenge, then defeat all twelve again on the very same ball to become the new Master.
goals.reward: 500M, a Special, and your initials go up as the new Master

steps.action: Defeat all twelve opponents once to reach the Challenge
steps.detail: Only two opponents are lit at a time on your second pass through, instead of three

steps.action: Clear the dual opponents together with one shot
steps.detail: All eight shots are lit simultaneously during the Challenge

steps.action: Clear the spiral's dual opponents together with one shot
Shoot the left ramp to raise it and expose the underpass below
Shoot the right ramp to raise it and expose its underpass
steps.detail: Ten total shots clears all twelve opponents

steps.action: Finish both raised shots to complete the Challenge
steps.detail: Lose the ball mid-Challenge and you forfeit it — the whole thing restarts next ball

goals.title: Strategy: Two-Shot Farm
goals.summary: A repeatable line for building TORPEDO fast: park on two easy shots, one per side, and just keep feeding them.

steps.action: Lean on the underpass as your left-side shot
steps.detail: An easy, controllable shot that also parks a ball briefly out of play, and it passes three switches for 9M a hit versus one or two on most other shots

steps.action: Lean on the other underpass as your right-side shot
steps.detail: Feeds the top pop bumper, which together with the Green Targets often nets five or more switch hits — roughly 15M — off a single shot, and repeated visits can light the extra ball too

goals.title: Strategy: Save the Hard Shots
goals.summary: Take your easy jackpots early in the ladder and save the tough ones for the middle, so an easy shot is what's left over for the repeatable Super Jackpot.

steps.action: Take the loopback jackpot early in the ladder rather than saving it
steps.detail: It's one of the toughest shots in the game — you don't want it left over as your Super Jackpot target

steps.action: Take the spiral jackpot early too, for the same reason
Aim to have an easy hole left over for the Super Jackpot
steps.detail: An easy leftover shot means reshooting 300M repeatedly instead of fighting for a single one

achievements.title: Perfect Timing
achievements.desc: Land a dead-center Bracelet hit off a perfectly timed plunge.

achievements.title: Special Delivery
achievements.desc: Complete FIGHTER and light a Special at a flipper-selectable lane.

achievements.title: Total Wreck
achievements.desc: Crunch the car before time runs out in the mini-playfield.

achievements.title: Sonic Boom
achievements.desc: Spell GUILE for the first time in a game.

achievements.title: Green Light Special
achievements.desc: Light and collect the Extra Ball target off the Green Targets.

achievements.title: Combo Breaker
achievements.desc: Land the 1-2 Punch — Blanka into Ken & Ryu inside twenty seconds.

achievements.title: Fire The Torpedo
achievements.desc: Complete TORPEDO and start the three-ball frenzy multiball.

achievements.title: Fourth Ninja Down
achievements.desc: Chain all four Roaming Ninjas hits in a single round.

achievements.title: Perfect Count
achievements.desc: Time the Count-Up hole for its full 48M peak value.

achievements.title: Everything Doubled
achievements.desc: Clear all four Double Score shots before time runs out.

achievements.title: Eighth Jackpot
achievements.desc: Reach and collect the 300M Super Jackpot at the spiral.

achievements.title: The New Master
achievements.desc: Complete the Champion Challenge and enter your initials as Master.
